Ulysses knew he'd fall for the sirens' song. So he had himself tied to the mast.

Most traders don't lose to the market. They lose to themselves at 3am.

See what your own sirens cost you: {bot} ⚓

Paper hands aren't a character flaw. They're a pattern.

And patterns can be measured. Drop your Solana wallet into {bot} and get your Paper Hands Score (0-100). Read-only, no keys, no connect.

🔐 Safety reminder: Mastbound will NEVER ask for your seed phrase, private key or a wallet signature to 'verify' anything in DMs.

Anyone who does is a scammer. Report and block.
headline: We will never ask for your seed phrase. Anyone who does is a scammer.

text:
Three habits the Regret Mirror looks for:

📉 Panic sell: selling after a sharp drop, right before a bounce
🚀 FOMO buy: buying after a big pump, right before a dip
🧻 Early sell: selling, then watching it run

Which one is yours?
headline: Panic sells. FOMO buys. Early exits. Which one is yours?

text:
A score of 0 = Iron Captain. Sirens sing, you don't blink.
A score of 100 = Paper Boat. One wave and you're gone.

Where do you land? {bot} 🌊

Rule of the mast: decide BEFORE the storm, not during it.

Write your exit plan when you're calm. Follow it when you're not.

Regret isn't about the top you missed. It's about the plan you abandoned.

The Regret Mirror shows you which sells were the wind's idea, not yours.

How the Regret Mirror measures an 'early sell': after you sell, if the price climbed 10%+ above your sell price within 30 days, and you didn't buy back — that gap is counted.

Rebuys are offset. Recent trades wait until there's enough data.
headline: An early sell = the price ran 10%+ above your exit within 30 days.

text:
Not financial advice. Never will be.

Mastbound doesn't tell you what to buy. It shows you how YOU behave when prices move. That's the part you can actually change.
headline: We don't tell you what to buy. We show you how you behave.

headline: Share your card, not your keys.

text:
The best traders aren't fearless. They built systems that don't depend on how they feel.

Coming to Mastbound: the Ulysses Lock — tie yourself to the mast before the storm.

Quick self-check before any trade:

1. Would I make this trade if the chart were flat yesterday?
2. Is my exit written down?
3. Am I reacting to a number or to a feeling?
headline: Before any trade: is my exit written down?

text:
FOMO has a signature: price up 30%+ in 3 days, you buy the top, and it drops 15% before it ever runs.

The Regret Mirror counts how often you've signed it.
Tip: in a Telegram group, use /regret <wallet address> and the whole crew gets the card. Friendly competition for the calmest hands. ⚓
headline: /regret in your group chat. Calmest hands win.
